input.rationale: The Agreement contains no indemnification, defence or hold-harmless language anywhere (searches for "indemnif", "hold harmless" and "liability" return only the no-joint-venture clause), and no limitation of liability. HDI is the vendor: it designs, develops, hosts, operates and promotes the Site (Sections 1.1-1.8) and performs "Services" for the Company (Section 8.1), yet bears no obligation to defend the Company against third-party claims, including IP infringement claims arising from the Site, HDI's software/systems or HDI's promotional activity (Section 7.2 only contains a covenant, with no indemnity). This fails the preferred position, so we insert a vendor indemnity as new Section 9(c), immediately after the warranty section and before General Provisions; it will survive under Section 10.7 (which preserves Section 9). Customer-side exposure is limited by carving out Company-provided Content and Marks; no Company indemnity is added.

proposal.summary: Add HDI (vendor) indemnity for third-party IP claims, breach of law, HDI-caused data incidents and misconduct
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement contains no indemnity at all, so we have added an HDI indemnity covering third-party IP infringement claims relating to the Site and HDI's services, HDI's breach of law, HDI-caused data incidents and HDI's gross negligence or willful misconduct, with standard notice, control and cooperation mechanics. HDI builds, hosts and operates the Site, so it should stand behind claims arising from what it delivers; we can discuss customary IP exclusions (Company Content, Marks, specifications and modifications) if helpful.

ops.text: Indemnification by HDI. HDI shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless the Company and its affiliates from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, losses, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (1) an allegation that the Site, the services performed by HDI hereunder or any software, systems or materials provided by HDI (excluding Content or Marks provided by the Company) infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right; (2) HDI's breach of applicable law; (3) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Content, Confidential Information or customer or user data caused by HDI; or (4) HDI's gross negligence or willful misconduct. The Company shall promptly notify HDI of any such claim, HDI shall have control of the defense and settlement thereof (provided that no settlement imposing any liability, obligation or admission on the Company shall be entered into without the Company's prior written consent), and the Company shall provide reasonable cooperation at HDI's expense.
